  • We are still just getting started: Backed by the world's best consumer investors, we aim to revolutionize the soft drink industry and build a generational love brand: tastier, healthier & more sustainable. Our team of 200+ people aims high (Coca-Cola, we're coming for you!).


About the Position

HOLY is growing fast: with new product launches, expanding retail partnerships, and an ever-increasing customer base driving demand across all channels.

To keep pace with this momentum, we are looking for a Logistics Manager with a clear focus on Retail and a strong connection to D2C Logistics. You will make sure that retail orders are prepared completely and delivered on time, while also supporting reliable D2C fulfillment, inventory flow, and customer experience.

This role is highly operational and hands-on. You are the kind of person who spots a problem, takes ownership, and fixes it before it becomes a bigger issue.

Retail Logistics Ownership

  • Take end-to-end responsibility for ensuring that retail orders are complete and ready for shipment on time.
  • Own Retail OTIF performance and proactively steer against deviations with fulfillment partners and retail customers.

D2C Logistics Support
  • Support reliable D2C order fulfillment, inventory flow, replenishment, and delivery performance.
  • Monitor open operational issues and coordinate quick resolutions with fulfillment partners, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and E-Commerce.
  • Support accurate system synchronization across warehouses and sales channels.

3PL Partnership & Operations Oversight
  • Act as an operational contact for our fulfillment partners across Retail and D2C topics.
  • Ensure SLA adherence and daily operational stability.
  • Escalate and resolve deviations in speed, accuracy, availability, or cost efficiency swiftly.

Performance Analysis & Reporting
  • Track retail and D2C logistics KPIs and turn them into actionable insights.
  • Use partner reports and internal dashboards to identify risks, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain clear SOPs, documentation, and performance reporting for internal visibility.
Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Act as the communication bridge between Logistics, Inside Sales, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and external partners.
  • Keep stakeholders informed of critical operational updates, risks, and changes.
  • Lead root-cause investigations and coordinate quick resolutions to protect customer experience.
Process Improvement & Scalability
  • Improve recurring logistics workflows across Retail and D2C.
  • Identify efficiency and cost-reduction opportunities and track implementation progress.
  • Help build scalable logistics playbooks for HOLY's omnichannel growth.


About You

  • Retail-Ops-Ownership: You take full end-to-end responsibility for retail order readiness and OTIF performance, proactively steering against deviations before they become escalations.
  • 3PL & partner management: Proven experience managing fulfillment partners operationally - holding them to SLAs, resolving deviations in speed, accuracy or cost quickly and calmly.
  • Cross-functional coordination: Comfortable acting as the bridge between Logistics, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service and Supply Chain, keeping stakeholders aligned even when things move fast.
  • Analytical & KPI-driven: Skilled at turning partner reports and internal dashboards into actionable insights, spotting risks and recurring issues early.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in English and German is a must.


Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

  • A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitable and quickly for the last 36+ months and have just raised a series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
  • Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY’s internationalisation in a top market.
  • Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
  • Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
  • Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
  • Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauerberg, flexible working hours, and much more.
  • Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity—giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.


The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

  1. Getting to know you: After reviewing your CV, Eric, our Talent Acquisition Manager, will have a 30-minute screening interview with you to discuss more about HOLY and the position and see if our expectations match.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview with Jan: Deep dive into your experience and approach with Jan, our Senior Logistics Manager.

  6. Job offer and decision: If everything goes well, you will receive an offer and we are ready to embark on this journey together with you!
Typically his process should take around 2 weeks.

Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest extrem strukturiert, bringst eine hohe Lösungsorientierung mit und bewahrst bei umfassenden Content Rollouts stets die Ruhe. title: Werkstudent:in Landwirtschaft und betriebliche Datenprüfung (all genders) (Berlin I DE Remote möglich)
description: Please note: This job description is written in German as the role requires fluency in German and active collaboration with German-speaking stakeholders. We want to ensure clarity around expectations and language needs from the start. Startdatum: ab 07.09.2026 - Befristet bis 28.02.2027 Bei Klim arbeiten wir mit Landwirten und Lebensmittelunternehmen zusammen, um regenerative Landwirtschaft skalierbar und für Landwirte finanziell attraktiv zu gestalten. Über unsere Plattform unterstützen wir Landwirte dabei, die Bodengesundheit wiederherzustellen, die Artenvielfalt zu fördern und CO₂ zu binden – und gleichzeitig neue, verlässliche Einnahmequellen zu erschließen. Als Berliner AgriTech-Startup – unterstützt durch eine Series-A-Finanzierung in Höhe von 22 Millionen US-Dollar – arbeiten wir mit führenden globalen Lebensmittelunternehmen wie Nestlé und Kaufland zusammen. Gemeinsam reduzieren wir Emissionen in deren Lieferketten und stärken die langfristige Resilienz. Seit 2020 haben wir bereits 3.500 Landwirte unterstützt, die zusammen mehr als 900.000 Hektar bewirtschaften. Wenn du dich für ein nachhaltiges Ernährungssystem und echten Klimaschutz begeisterst, komm zu uns und hilf mit, einen gesünderen Planeten zu schaffen! Deine Mission Klim begleitet Landwirt:innen und Unternehmen bei der Umstellung auf regenerative Landwirtschaft. Klim hat eine digitale Plattform entwickelt, die den Betrieben eine einfache Möglichkeit bietet, ihre regenerativen Maßnahmen zu dokumentieren, Finanzierungen für ihre umgesetzten Maßnahmen zu erhalten und vom Fachwissen einer engagierten Community zu profitieren. Gemeinsam mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben und teilnehmenden Unternehmen setzt sich Klim mit dieser Arbeit dafür ein, den CO2-Ausstoß in der Landwirtschaft nachhaltig zu reduzieren, die Bodengesundheit zu verbessern und Artenvielfalt zu fördern. Um Qualität und Integrität der Arbeit sicherzustellen, hat Klim einen eigenen Monitoring, Reporting und Verifizierungsprozess (MRV) entwickelt. Als Teil unseres MRV (Monitoring, Reporting and Verification)-Teams stellst du in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren landwirtschaftlichen Partnerbetrieben die Qualität und Transparenz unserer Ergebnisse sicher. Deine Aufgaben Du arbeitest als Werkstudent:in in unserem Verifizierungsteam. Deine Aufgabe besteht in der Prüfung von Betriebsdaten hinsichtlich der umgesetzten Maßnahmen der Betriebe. Du durchsichtest sorgfältig Betriebsdokumenten wie Agraranträge, Ackerschlagkartei, Düngebedarfsermittlungen, Saatgutbelege, Dienstleistungsrechnungen und Inventarlisten und überprüfst, dass die Datenlage auf unserer Plattform in Einklang mit der Dokumentation steht. Mit deinem agrarwissenschaftlichen Fachwissen prüfst du die Plausibilität von den eingesetzten regenerativen Maßnahmen, wie Fruchtfolgen, Düngemittelverwendung und Bodenbearbeitung. Du stehst in engem Kontakt mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben zur Klärung von Fragen. Mit deiner Arbeit stellst du sicher, dass die von unserem Modell berechneten CO₂-Einspeicherungen und Einsparungen tatsächlich erreicht wurden. Dein Profil Du bist aktuell als Student:in an einer deutschen Universität eingeschrieben, vorzugsweise in Agrarwissenschaften, Umweltwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – oder bringst praktische Erfahrungen in der Landwirtschaft mit, z.B. durch persönlichen Hintergrund Du bringst großes Interesse an regenerativer Landwirtschaft und nachhaltigen Lösungen mit. Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und hast Freude an der direkten Kommunikation mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben – telefonisch und per E-Mail. Selbstständiges, strukturiertes und verantwortungsbewusstes Arbeiten sind für dich selbstverständlich. Du bist versiert im Umgang mit digitalen Tools. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Deine Benefits Growth : Einblicke in alle Arbeitsbereiche eines agilen Start-Ups und wertvolles Wissen über die moderne Arbeitswelt. Opportunity : Arbeite bei einem innovativen Unternehmen für regenerative Landwirtschaft und gestalte aktiv mit, wie wir unsere Ziele erreichen. Impact : Dein Engagement trägt täglich zur Zukunftssicherheit der Landwirtschaft, zur Bodengesundheit und zum Klimaschutz bei. Autonomy : Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Flexibles Arbeitsmodell : Wir fördern flexibles, hybrides Arbeiten und ermöglichen es dir, aus unserem Berliner Büro oder remote zu arbeiten. Weitere Benefits für Mitarbeiter:innen in Deutschland: Wir bieten eine Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club oder das Deutschlandticket, Team-Lunches (in Berlin) sowie regelmäßige Team-Events. Wir freuen uns auf Dich! Bei Klim sind wir überzeugt, dass ein lebendiger und erfolgreicher Arbeitsplatz auf den vielfältigen Hintergründen, Talenten und Perspektiven unseres Teams basiert. Gemeinsam werden wir stärker, indem wir die individuellen Stärken jeder einzelnen Person wertschätzen und weiterentwickeln. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich alle geschätzt fühlen und die Möglichkeit haben, ihr volles Potenzial einzubringen. Alle Einstellungs- und Personalentscheidungen treffen wir ausschließlich auf Grundlage von Qualifikationen, Leistung und den Bedürfnissen des Unternehmens – und gewährleisten so Fairness und Chancengleichheit für alle. Wenn dich diese Position begeistert, du aber nicht jede einzelne Anforderung erfüllst, ermutigen wir dich dennoch, dich zu bewerben. Vielleicht passt du auf eine Weise perfekt zu unserem Team, die du dir noch gar nicht vorstellen kannst! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Um Qualität und Integrität der Arbeit sicherzustellen, hat Klim einen eigenen Monitoring, Reporting und Verifizierungsprozess (MRV) entwickelt.

  • Mit deinem agrarwissenschaftlichen Fachwissen prüfst du die Plausibilität von den eingesetzten regenerativen Maßnahmen, wie Fruchtfolgen, Düngemittelverwendung und Bodenbearbeitung.

  • Du stehst in engem Kontakt mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben zur Klärung von Fragen.

  • Du bist aktuell als Student:in an einer deutschen Universität eingeschrieben, vorzugsweise in Agrarwissenschaften, Umweltwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – oder bringst praktische Erfahrungen in der Landwirtschaft mit, z.B. durch persönlichen Hintergrund

  • Du bringst großes Interesse an regenerativer Landwirtschaft und nachhaltigen Lösungen mit.

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und hast Freude an der direkten Kommunikation mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben – telefonisch und per E-Mail.

description: Overview PR steht vor einem strukturellen Bruch. Vertrauen verschiebt sich, Sichtbarkeit wird neu verteilt, KI wächst exponentiell. Wir bei getpress glauben, dass Reputation in den nächsten zehn Jahren der entscheidende Wettbewerbsvorsprung für Unternehmen wird. Und dass die Agentur, die das ernst nimmt, anders aussehen muss als die Agentur von gestern. Deshalb bauen wir die PR Company der Zukunft . Outcome-getrieben statt Retainer-Stunden. KI-first statt KI-on-top. Automatisiert, wo es skaliert und menschlich, wo es wirklich zählt. Unser über 40 köpfiges Team aus Journalist*innen und PR-Strateg*innen hat seit 2017 die PR für 450+ der spannendsten Wachstumsunternehmen Europas gesteuert – und hat Hunger auf mehr. Bist du dabei? Deine Rolle Strategisch und themensicher: Du entwickelst individuelle PR Strategien für Kunden aus dem B2B- und B2C-Bereich – mit klarem Fokus auf Themenplatzierung in relevanten Medien. Dabei bringst du journalistisches Denken und strategische Kommunikation zusammen. Beratend auf Augenhöhe: Du steuerst die Kommunikation mit deinen Kund*innen professionell, planst vorausschauend (z. B. mit Quartalsplänen & KPIs) und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf. Du bringst proaktiv Themen ein – und entwickelst die Kommunikation deiner Kund*innen kontinuierlich weiter. Du bist Sparringspartner*in auf C-Level-Augenhöhe, nicht Auftragsempfänger*in. Teamorientiert & offen: Du teilst dein Wissen, gibst und nimmst Peer-to-Peer-Feedback über alle Erfahrungslevel hinweg, ohne Gatekeeping, mit echtem Interesse an gemeinsamer Weiterentwicklung. Vorne auf der AI Welle: Du arbeitest aktiv mit unserem internen AI-Stack. Recherche, Pitch-Vorbereitung, Themen-Scouting – wo Maschinen schneller sind, lassen wir sie machen. Du investierst die gewonnene Zeit in Substanz, Beziehungen und Kreativität. Aktives Netzwerken: Du baust und pflegst belastbare Beziehungen zu Journalist*innen aus den wichtigsten Medien im DACH Raum und Europas. Wer du bist 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in der operativen PR, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld, und hast Kund*innen nachweislich eigenständig in deutschen Leit- und Fachmedien platziert. Du bringst fundierte Beratungskompetenz mit, analysierst Zielgruppen und Märkte, übersetzt Unternehmensziele in PR Strategien, leitest messbare Maßnahmen ab und begleitest deine Kund*innen als verlässliche* Sparringspartner*in auf Augenhöhe. Du hast ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Journalist*innen und weißt, wie man vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufbaut und pflegt. Du beobachtest die Nachrichtenlage aktiv und erkennst Themenpotenziale, bevor andere sie auf dem Schirm haben. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, bringst dich ins Team ein und teilst dein Wissen offen. Du nutzt KI-Tools pragmatisch, um Prozesse zu beschleunigen, damit mehr Zeit für inhaltliche Tiefe und kreative Ideen bleibt. Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2- Niveau, kannst auch auf Englisch professionell kommunizieren und lebst in Deutschland Was dich erwartet Journalistische PR statt Massenversand: Bei uns gibt es keine generischen Pressemitteilungen oder Gießkannenverteiler. Wir arbeiten individuell, redaktionell und mit klarer Themenstrategie und pitchen gezielt per Telefon bei passenden Journalist*innen aus einem breiten Medienspektrum. Langfristige Perspektive & Entwicklung: Du startest mit einem unbefristeten Vertrag. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir einen klaren Fahrplan für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung – mit regelmäßigen Feedbacks und transparenten Zielen. Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird: Ob remote (innerhalb Deutschlands), hybrid oder im Berliner Office – wir ermöglichen Arbeitsmodelle, die sich mit deinem privaten und beruflichen Leben gut vereinbaren lassen. Entscheidungsfreiheit, Eigenverantwortung und klare Kommunikation gehören für uns selbstverständlich dazu. Unterstützung und offene Arme: Wir begegnen einander auf Augenhöhe – offen, ehrlich und mit echtem Interesse am Gegenüber. Wir lernen voneinander, geben einander Rückhalt und feiern gemeinsame Erfolge. Eine Kultur von Challengern. Wir arbeiten ergebnisgetrieben, feiern Erfolge und erwarten, dass du uns challenged – und wir challengen zurück. Augenhöhe heißt bei uns: ehrliches Feedback in beide Richtungen. Eine Lernkurve, die du anderswo nicht bekommst. Du arbeitest täglich mit einem Team, das das fortschrittlichste AI PR System im Markt baut. Wer sich jetzt einbringt, baut sich ein Profil, das in der Branche selten ist. Benefits und Sweet Treats: Du kannst aus drei frei wählbaren Sachbezügen wählen, von einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit 20% Zuschuss auf deine Einzahlungen profitieren,180 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland arbeiten, dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents freuen. Und das Beste: Du startest mit 27 Urlaubstagen aber je länger du bei uns bist, desto mehr Urlaubstage bekommst du dazu. Unser nächsten Schritte Wenn du jetzt denkst: ,,Klingt nach mir!’’ , dann bewirb dich ohne Anschreiben bei uns und wer weiß, vielleicht bist du schon schneller als gedacht Teil unseres getpress-Teams! Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit ein und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung, Alter oder Behinderung. title: Senior Solutions Consultant (m/f/d) - Growth & Strategy
description: The Role This is a senior role combining consulting, technology and commercial responsibility . You’ll work directly with customers to understand their processes and challenges, then turn those requirements into practical Smartsheet solutions. You’ll build and present proof of concepts, scope consulting projects, discuss pricing and ultimately help win the work. You’ll play an important role in AMX’s continued growth, with an initial focus on the DACH market. You’ll work with opportunities from Smartsheet, our partner network and existing customers, while also helping develop new relationships over time. The focus is on building trust, understanding where AMX can add value and turning strong customer relationships into sustainable growth. There’s also real scope for this role to grow. With proven success, you’ll take on broader responsibility for how AMX develops opportunities and goes to market , initially through greater ownership of customers, regions and commercial strategy. Over time, this can also develop into mentoring and guiding the team as it grows. What You’ll Be Doing Manage customer opportunities end-to-end , from discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, proof of concepts, scoping, pricing and commercial discussions, before handing over to the implementation team. Build strong relationships with existing customers, identifying new use cases and opportunities to expand successful solutions across other teams, departments and markets. Work closely with Smartsheet Account Executives and the wider Smartsheet team on joint account planning, developing opportunities and identifying growth accounts across DACH and AMX’s wider markets. Help develop new opportunities through targeted account research, strategic outreach, events and collaboration with AMX’s marketing and partner network . Contribute to and help shape AMX’s wider consulting and commercial approach , including how we develop opportunities, work with partners and take solutions to market. As you progress, mentor other consultants and take on increasing responsibility across AMX’s commercial activities. Your profile You have strong experience in technology consulting, solutions consulting, SaaS or digital transformation . You’re commercially minded and comfortable taking a customer conversation from discovery through solution design, scoping, negotiation and close. You’re equally technically hands-on and comfortable actually building and demonstrating what you propose. Smartsheet experience is a big advantage, but strong Excel skills or experience configuring SaaS, workflow, low-code or business applications can also be a great fit. You’re good at asking the right questions and turning complex or unclear business problems into structured solutions . You’re confident presenting to senior stakeholders and can explain technical solutions in terms of business value. You enjoy building customer relationships and spotting new opportunities . You’re comfortable working without a perfect playbook. You like bringing your own ideas, testing what works and helping shape the processes and approach that will make AMX successful as we grow . You’re interested in growing beyond an individual contributor role, mentoring others and taking on broader responsibility over time . You speak German at native/C2 level and English fluently. You’re ideally based in Germany and comfortable travelling for customers, partner meetings and events , typically up to five days per month. A relevant degree is welcome, but your experience and what you’ve actually delivered are much more important to us. Why us? You’ll join an established and successful consultancy that is still small enough for you to have a real influence on how things are done. You’ll have genuine flexibility around where you work , with a remote-first setup and only occasional travel for customers, partner meetings and team events. The role comes with a strong fixed salary , with regular salary reviews as your responsibilities and seniority grow. You’ll receive a €3,000 annual learning and development budget , home-office support, a flexible €50 monthly benefits allowance, wellness and technology allowances and regular team retreats. You won’t simply be executing somebody else’s playbook. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, shape how we work and help define what successful growth looks like . Most importantly, there’s room for this to become much more than a typical Senior Consultant position. If things go well, we want you to take on broader commercial responsibility, help develop the team and play an important role in AMX’s continued growth across DACH and beyond. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (TypeScript, Next.js / Node.js) to join our Engineering team in Munich or working remotely from Germany. At Atolls, your role will play a key role in helping us provide a seamless web experience that enables users to find the Smart Shopping capability that best matches their intent through search, navigation, and a personalized home page, creating exceptional user experiences and empowering consumers to make informed and confident shopping decisions.   • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.

  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.

  • Drive feature development from inception to delivery, contributing to an ambitious product roadmap.
  • Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and hands-on exposure to emerging technologies.
  • Foster an open communication culture, encouraging feedback and supporting conflict resolution.

 Your Profile:

  • 6+ years of experience in software development.
  • Proficiency in Next.js / Node.js, with experience building reusable libraries using an atomic design system.
  • Strong foundation in object-oriented programming and concurrent event-based systems.

Join a company shaping a healthier world.</strong></p> <p><strong>GET TO KNOW US</strong></p> <p>At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.</p> <p>We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>People Operations Working Student</strong> to our <strong>People Operations</strong> team in <strong>Berlin</strong>!</p> <p>This role is to join our People Operations team, dedicated to delivering an exceptional employee experience across Europe. In this role, you will contribute to meaningful People initiatives and gain valuable exposure to key HR topics including employment law, payroll, and HR systems (e.g., Personio), all within a fast-paced, international environment</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>YOUR IMPACT</strong></p> <ul> <li>Address and resolve employee queries with clarity and care by guiding them to the right resources.</li> <li>Support payroll processing by accurately entering and validating HR data in a timely manner.</li> <li>Assist with internal audits, documentation, and the gathering of key compliance information.</li> <li>Maintain accurate HR data in Personio and support reporting to inform data-driven decision-making.</li> <li>Contribute to process optimization and strategic People projects spanning the entire employee lifecycle, including onboarding and offboarding.</li> <li>Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHO YOU ARE</strong></p> <ul> <li>A university student currently enrolled in HR, Business, or a related discipline, available to work between 15 and 20 hours per week.</li> <li>A fluent communicator with C1+ level proficiency in both written and spoken German and English.</li> <li>A Berlin-based candidate who can work on-site from our Head Office 2–3 times per week.</li> <li>A discreet professional with a proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with high integrity.</li> <li>A self-driven, adaptable, and collaborative team player with excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.</li> <li>A proactive learner passionate about employee experience, eager to develop skills in project management, stakeholder management, and HR operations across Europe.</li> </ul> <p>We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that <strong>current university enrollment and fluency in German and English (C1+) are mandatory requirements.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER YOU</strong></p> <p>With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:</p> <p><strong>WELLHUB:</strong>&nbsp; Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.</p> <p><strong>FLEXIBLE WORK:</strong> As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.</p> <p><strong>FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: </strong>&nbsp;Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.</p> <p><strong>PAID TIME OFF:</strong> We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>PARENTAL LEAVE:</strong> Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>CAREER GROWTH:</strong> Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,&nbsp; build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>CULTURE:</strong> You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. <a href="https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/our-values/">Learn more about our shared culture and values here.&nbsp;</a></p> <p><strong>Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on </strong><a href="https://www.instagram.com/lifeatwellhub/"><strong>Instagram</strong></a><strong> @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on </strong><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgIPiszTVm4"><strong>YouTube</strong></a><strong>!</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub</strong></p> <p>We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.</p> <p>Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.</p> <p>Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/posts/wellhub_fairpay-syndio-activity-7407826561531363328-wbN_?utm_source=share&amp;utm_medium=member_desktop&amp;rcm=ACoAAAzHQWABKsRqcpvxy4QpDCJNe_szRdC4hgY">Read more about it here.</a></p> <p>Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our <a href="https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/job-applicant-privacy-notice/">Job Applicant Privacy Notice.</a></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong>&nbsp;#LI-HYBRID</strong></span></p> <p><strong><span style="color: rgb(224, 62, 45);">&nbsp;</span></strong></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Full training will be provided.</em></p> <h2>Why you should join SumUp</h2> <ul> <li>🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office at Ostbahnhof</li> <li>🌈 Be part of an inclusive and collaborative environment where different perspectives are valued</li> <li>🏖️ 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days, pro-rated</li> <li>🚵🏾‍♂️ Access health and well-being support through our Employee Assistance Programme, an Urban Sports Club subsidy, and fitness activities, including on-site gym access, yoga sessions, and team sports</li> <li>🚆 Benefit from subsidised public transport with the Deutschlandticket, offering unlimited travel on local and regional transport across Germany</li> <li>🥗 Enjoy partially subsidised office lunches and weekly breakfast</li> <li>🔗 Receive additional rewards through our employee referral programme when referring talents to join our team</li> </ul> <h2>About SumUp</h2> <p>Be empowered to do more that matters.</p> <p>At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. title: Supply Chain Planning Working Student (all genders)
description: <h2><strong>Your role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Supply Chain planning working student for 12 months at the heart of our Product team, where you will be responsible for supporting our operational and strategic needs for our physical product: meal kits. You will be central to our activity and will have a significant influence on our customers' meals.</p> <p>We are looking for someone capable of assisting us in the operational planning of recipes at HelloFresh. description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually. Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second , we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time. Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake , providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange. Engineered for performance, our stack leverages Tensorflow and PyTorch for model training , NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference . We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem. The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day , 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines , and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second . What you will do: Analyze and evaluate the performance of our machine learning models using user-level and aggregated data, identify inefficiencies and failure patterns, and turn findings into actionable recommendations for our Data Science teams. Investigate how our ML models perform in the real world and compare model assumptions and predictions with actual user and business behavior. Identify gaps between offline model performance and online outcomes and help the team close them. Define and improve metrics for measuring ML model performance and business impact , working closely with Data Scientists and Product Managers to ensure we optimize for the right outcomes. Design, prepare and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to measure the impact of new models, features and algorithmic changes. Assess statistical significance, experiment quality and practical business impact. Build dashboards and automated reports that make ML model performance, experiments and key business metrics transparent and easy to understand for technical and non-technical stakeholders. Act as a bridge between Data Science, Product and Business teams , translating business questions into analytical problems and turning complex ML insights into clear recommendations and decisions. Challenge product and technical decisions with data , bringing an independent analytical perspective to model development, experimentation and product strategy. Document your analyses, methodologies and findings and build reusable analytical approaches that can be applied across models and experiments. Who you are: You have a degree in mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, economics, analytics , or a similar quantitative field. You have 5+ years of relevant experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Experimentation, Data Science or a similar role. Experience in AdTech, mobile apps or ML-driven products is a strong plus. You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy digging into data to understand why something happens , not just what happened. You’re proficient in SQL and comfortable working with large datasets. You have strong Python or R skills and are comfortable using them for data analysis and statistical modelling. You have a solid understanding of statistics and experimentation , including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, statistical significance and A/B test analysis. You have an understanding of machine learning concepts and model evaluation and are comfortable working with Data Scientists. You don't necessarily need to build ML models yourself, but you should understand how to assess their performance and limitations. You have experience working with model and business metrics , and can connect technical model performance to real-world business outcomes. You have excellent data visualization skills and experience building dashboards using tools such as QuickSight, Power BI, Tableau, R Shiny, Streamlit or similar. You are comfortable communicating complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences . Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals. Easy Arrival to adjoe: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at adjoe in Hamburg? We support every ambition—from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home. Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: We work in a hybrid setup with 3 core office days, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster lake view from our central office with top notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks. Join the Community! title: Senior Product Manager (Licensing & Billing)
description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on. This is a foundations role. You build the system that pricing and packaging decisions run on, rather than running price experiments yourself. To do so, here are your core responsibilities: OWN THE LICENSING & BILLING STRATEGY & ROADMAP Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for Licensing & Billing in partnership with Engineering, Product leadership, Finance, and go-to-market. Prioritize foundational investments based on revenue integrity, enterprise needs, data correctness, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs explicit. Lead discovery with enterprise customers, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and RevOps to understand how n8n is bought, renewed, and grown today, and where that breaks. LICENSING, ENTITLEMENTS & ACCOUNTS Own the license server and entitlement model: issuance, renewal, and validation across Cloud, self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments, with one source of truth for which plan or deal grants which features. Introduce "account" as a first-class product primitive (accounts, purchases, license keys, activations) and expose it as the API contract our customer-facing console and multi-instance management are built on. Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps. METERING & BILLING PLATFORM Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging. Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform. Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging. CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards. Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on. Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery. REQUIREMENTS Must-haves Billing or licensing product experience: You have 6+ years in Product, with a substantial part spent owning a billing, licensing, entitlement, or quote-to-cash system at a B2B SaaS company. Shipped through Finance and RevOps: You've driven a cross-functional systems change where Finance, Sales Ops, and Engineering all had a say, and you got it live. Systems and data-model depth: You can design or critique an entity model, reason about reconciliation and idempotency in a sync, read an API contract, and explain why two systems reading the same events end up with different numbers. Attention to detail: You know that if the billing data is wrong, everything built on it inherits the error, and you sequence work accordingly. Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or data-quality work to commercial outcomes. Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction. Exceptional communication: You're equally at home with engineers, the Finance team, and Sales, and you can make billing trade-offs legible to all of them. Enterprise reality: You understand what self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments mean for licensing and metering. Nice-to-haves Usage-based billing: You've owned usage-based or hybrid (subscription plus usage) billing. Vendor billing stacks: You've worked hands-on with Paddle, Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora or similar, and know where they break at enterprise contract volume. Migration experience: You've run a billing-provider migration. Hands-on ability: You can read code, query data, or prototype, even if you're not shipping it. CRM integration: You've worked on Salesforce or CRM-to-billing integrations. Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, agent orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products. Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment. Why join us? At n8n, you'll be in the middle of the AI revolution. The shift from deterministic automation to agent autonomy is a genuinely open design space, and n8n has a credible claim to owning it. Every plan we sell, every enterprise contract, and every agent run that gets metered and billed runs on the foundation you own: licensing, entitlements, accounts, and the billing platform across Cloud and Enterprise. Your work directly shapes how n8n makes money and how easily customers can buy, grow, and trust what they pay for, from self-serve Cloud to air-gapped and OEM deployments. You'll join one of Europe's fastest growing startups at the sweet spot: small enough to have real impact and be empowered, big enough that your work already reaches massive scale and serious enterprise customers. You'll work with experienced engineers, Finance, and go-to-market on problems where the details are the product, in an AI-native, empowered culture of humble, kind, yet driven and direct people, where you're hired to think, not just to execute. And with our fair-code model, a passionate open-source community gives you a direct feedback loop on everything you ship. Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on? Apply now, and help us build the commercial foundation of the future of reliable AI automation. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Health & wellness 🩺 – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US : Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. Future planning 💰 – Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.* US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. Financial security 🛡️ – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description. raw.title: Senior Product Manager (Licensing & Billing)
raw.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on.

This is a foundations role. You build the system that pricing and packaging decisions run on, rather than running price experiments yourself. To do so, here are your core responsibilities:

OWN THE LICENSING & BILLING STRATEGY & ROADMAP

  • Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for Licensing & Billing in partnership with Engineering, Product leadership, Finance, and go-to-market.

  • Prioritize foundational investments based on revenue integrity, enterprise needs, data correctness, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs explicit.

  • Lead discovery with enterprise customers, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and RevOps to understand how n8n is bought, renewed, and grown today, and where that breaks.

LICENSING, ENTITLEMENTS & ACCOUNTS

  • Own the license server and entitlement model: issuance, renewal, and validation across Cloud, self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments, with one source of truth for which plan or deal grants which features.

  • Introduce "account" as a first-class product primitive (accounts, purchases, license keys, activations) and expose it as the API contract our customer-facing console and multi-instance management are built on.

  • Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps.

METERING & BILLING PLATFORM

  • Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging.

  • Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform.

  • Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging.

CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

  • Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards.

  • Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on.

  • Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Billing or licensing product experience: You have 6+ years in Product, with a substantial part spent owning a billing, licensing, entitlement, or quote-to-cash system at a B2B SaaS company.

  • Shipped through Finance and RevOps: You've driven a cross-functional systems change where Finance, Sales Ops, and Engineering all had a say, and you got it live.

  • Systems and data-model depth: You can design or critique an entity model, reason about reconciliation and idempotency in a sync, read an API contract, and explain why two systems reading the same events end up with different numbers.

  • Attention to detail: You know that if the billing data is wrong, everything built on it inherits the error, and you sequence work accordingly.

  • Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or data-quality work to commercial outcomes.

  • Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

  • Exceptional communication: You're equally at home with engineers, the Finance team, and Sales, and you can make billing trade-offs legible to all of them.

  • Enterprise reality: You understand what self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments mean for licensing and metering.

Nice-to-haves

  • Usage-based billing: You've owned usage-based or hybrid (subscription plus usage) billing.

  • Vendor billing stacks: You've worked hands-on with Paddle, Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora or similar, and know where they break at enterprise contract volume.

  • Migration experience: You've run a billing-provider migration.

  • Hands-on ability: You can read code, query data, or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

  • CRM integration: You've worked on Salesforce or CRM-to-billing integrations.

  • Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, agent orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

  • Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll be in the middle of the AI revolution. The shift from deterministic automation to agent autonomy is a genuinely open design space, and n8n has a credible claim to owning it. Every plan we sell, every enterprise contract, and every agent run that gets metered and billed runs on the foundation you own: licensing, entitlements, accounts, and the billing platform across Cloud and Enterprise. Your work directly shapes how n8n makes money and how easily customers can buy, grow, and trust what they pay for, from self-serve Cloud to air-gapped and OEM deployments.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest growing startups at the sweet spot: small enough to have real impact and be empowered, big enough that your work already reaches massive scale and serious enterprise customers. You'll work with experienced engineers, Finance, and go-to-market on problems where the details are the product, in an AI-native, empowered culture of humble, kind, yet driven and direct people, where you're hired to think, not just to execute. And with our fair-code model, a passionate open-source community gives you a direct feedback loop on everything you ship.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now, and help us build the commercial foundation of the future of reliable AI automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring a Public Sector Enterprise Account Executive II to join our Sales team.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

As an Enterprise Account Executive II, you'll own the full sales cycle for a defined set of Public Sector enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, partnering with sales engineering, customer success, and your manager to navigate complex deals. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

This role gives you a book of enterprise accounts to grow and a real say in how you build your territory. You'll work complex deals with multiple stakeholders, and you'll have the support of sales engineering and customer success behind you as you build credibility and close. Camunda’s capabilities are well-aligned to the use cases that will help the DACH Administration digitize and automate for more efficiency and agility - this is an opportunity to shape and build a large and meaningful business!

What You Will Do

  • Build a territory plan that identifies Land opportunities and Expand possibilities, leveraging your extended resources such as Partners, Marketing, Inside Sales, Customer Success.

  • Build account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and economic buyers.

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure a smooth handoff and adoption after close.

  • Represent Camunda's value to business and technical buyers, tailoring the message to what each audience actually cares about.

  • Handle tender processes with precision, observe pipeline health with discipline, manage Forecast with accuracy.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Solid experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end in DACH, with a track record across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

  • Efficient balance between driving towards a customer vision and achieving short-term projects towards this horizon.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with own initiative. The playbook will not provide all answers in advance!

  • Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked complex deals involving IT, business, and procurement stakeholders, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

  • Developing territory and account planning instincts, orchestrating resources efficiently. You can build a plan with some independence, not just work from a list handed to you, and you're learning to prioritize where your time actually pays off.

  • Experience navigating complex public procurement procedures - knowing and following the processes but also influencing them with initiative and creativity.

  • Comfort selling technical products. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage here, particularly in a Public Sector context, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

  • Negotiation experience under real pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

raw.description:
🚀 About Nivoda

Nivoda is a fast-growing B2B marketplace that is transforming the global diamond and gemstone industry. We connect buyers and sellers across the world, processing $300M+ in annual transactions and unlocking a $350B industry opportunity. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.

 

🌍 Our Mission

The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.

 
 

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Marketing Lead to own how Nivoda explains itself: the positioning, the messaging, and the story that makes independent jewellers understand why we are worth switching to. This is the foundation the rest of marketing is built on, from paid campaigns to sales conversations. You will define who we are for, what we say, and why it lands, and then arm the whole go-to-market team to say it consistently.

This is a hands-on role. You will own positioning and messaging, lead the go-to-market for new product launches, sharpen our competitive edge, and build the sales enablement that turns interest into customers.

You will start as a senior individual contributor with real ownership of product marketing end to end. As the company grows there is room to build a function beneath you, but this is a role for a builder who wants to do the work, not just direct it.

 

What would you be doing?

  • Own Nivoda’s positioning and messaging: define who we are for, the problems we solve, and the words we use, and keep them sharp as the business evolves.

  • Lead the go-to-market for product launches. Shape the narrative, coordinate across teams, and make sure new features land with the jewellers they are built for.

  • Build the competitive intelligence that keeps us ahead: understand the alternatives jewellers weigh, and give the team the arguments that win.

  • Arm our sales team with the enablement they need, from one-pagers and decks to talk tracks, so every conversation tells a consistent and compelling story.

  • Own the messaging and narrative on our core product and positioning pages, partnering with the teams who own the website and the signup experience.

  • Shape our pricing and packaging story so the value is obvious and easy to say yes to.

  • Feed clear, tested messaging into demand gen and content, so campaigns ladder up to one coherent point of view without ever feeling like an ad.

  • Ground everything in customer truth: talk to jewellers, run win/loss, and turn what you learn into sharper positioning.

  • Partner closely with product and the growth PM so what we build and how we talk about it stay in lockstep.

 

What do we need from you?

  • 5+ years in product marketing, ideally at a B2B or marketplace company, with a track record of positioning and launches that moved the business.

  • You are a builder. You would rather write the messaging, run the launch, and ship the deck than hand it off.

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling. You can take something complex and make it simple, sharp, and persuasive.

  • A strategic head for positioning: you can define a market, a segment, and a wedge, and defend your choices.

  • Comfort with data and customer research. You start from evidence, not opinion.

  • You work well across functions, especially with sales and product, and you build trust quickly.

  • Comfort as a senior IC on a small team, building process where none exists, with the ambition to grow a function over time.

  • You are AI forward, always testing new tools, and learnings new applications of AI to improve your efficiency and effectiveness

 

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing to small business owners, retailers, or a trade audience.

  • A marketplace, self-serve, or product-led growth background.

  • Sales enablement experience for an SDR or inside-sales motion.

  • Experience running competitive intelligence or win/loss programs.

  • A real interest in jewellery, retail, or craft, or the curiosity to fall for the space quickly.

Our culture and what we offer

We're a high-growth company in an exponential expansion phase. We move fast, operate with low hierarchy, and give people real ownership from day one. If you want to work somewhere you can genuinely shape things: not just maintain them: Nivoda is the place.

 

Our current benefits

  • 🕐 Flexible working hours and vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 📈 Opportunities for growth and learning

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

Equal Opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let that stop you from applying: we hire for potential and mindset, not just a checklist.

title: Robot Pilot
description: At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality. Role Description: Tier 2 Robot Pilots are trusted, high-output robot teleoperators who reliably collect high-quality manipulation data using VR teleoperation systems. Pilots operate with minimal supervision, consistently meet data throughput and quality standards, and can troubleshoot routine issues (such as basic software workflow and lab operating issues). They also support researchers with executing evaluation protocols and providing clear feedback on robot and model behavior. Primary Duties ● Collect high-quality robot training data by teleoperating robotic systems using VR equipment and hand controllers; demonstrate manipulation tasks repeatedly and consistently. ● Meet daily performance expectations for data collection throughput, quality, and consistency (including correct task setup and complete metadata/notes). ● Follow task specifications and SOPs precisely, maintain discipline around experiment changes and “what changed” between sessions. ● Maintain a safe work environment and adhere to lab safety procedures at all times. ● Support evaluations by running structured evaluation protocols alongside researchers and accurately reporting results and issues. Additional Tasks: ● Troubleshoot and report issues with robot hardware/software and teleop tooling, capture relevant logs/notes and escalate with clear reproduction steps. ● Perform basic operational maintenance per SOP (workspace reset between sessions, calibration checks, battery swaps or component swaps as required). ● Review/annotate recordings as needed (lightweight review for quality checks, labeling support, or spot audits). ● Participate in process improvements to increase data collection efficiency, reduce downtime, and improve data quality. ● Occasional travel to customer/partner sites (domestic & international) to support on-site robot data collection, including operating in new environments, coordinating with site contacts, and following site-specific safety and security requirements. ● Occasional weekend overtime data collection (maximum one day per weekend), balanced with flexible scheduling and time off during the week. Required Qualifications: ● Strong VR / controller proficiency (VR gaming or similar real-time control experience). ● Ability to maintain focus while operating in VR for extended periods and follow detailed written/video instructions. ● Comfort working hands-on with robotics equipment in a lab environment; safety-minded and detail-oriented. ● Comfortable with Linux / command line (running programs with arguments, checking logs). ● Ability to debug routine issues and distinguish between environment/setup vs software vs hardware problems. ● Ability to write detailed bug reports when issues arise, document failure modes and participate in investigative efforts to diagnose and recover quickly. ● Reliable attendance and punctuality; able to work a fixed full-time shift (AM or PM). ● Basic technical literacy: comfortable navigating computer tools, documenting work, and communicating clearly. ● Able to stand/sit for extended periods, perform repetitive motions, and support physical reset tasks as needed (may include lifting/moving items up to ~30 lbs, squatting/standing during resets). Preferred: ● Experience with robotics systems, lab work, automation, manufacturing/assembly, or other precision technical work. ● Experience supporting structured experiments/evaluations with researchers or engineers. ● Experience collecting teleop demonstration data (robots, simulators, or other real-time control systems). raw.title: Software Engineer, Foundation
raw.description:
Job Description

In short: We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our foundation team with a focus on mobile. You don't need to have years of experience in platform engineering But, you do need to have shipped real production software, to care about how things are built, and to already be working with agentic coding tools every day.

We're building the #1 AI learning companion for 1 billion students. A future where every student on the planet can access, enjoy & benefit from the highest quality education. Since founding Knowunity straight out of high school in 2020, we've been committed to revolutionising how students learn.

Millions of students already use our AI learning companion weekly. We just raised €27m - Europe’s largest education round in the past three years. The AI learning market is at an inflection point, finally enabling true personalisation at scale, and we're determined to build the first AI learning unicorn in this space.

You will join an elite team of +60 hands-on builders serving 1 billion students worldwide. If we execute on our product vision, you will have built something generational that transforms education globally. This is your chance to build a generational company that shapes how an entire generation learns.

 


What makes this different

You build at the frontier of AI engineering. We’re building the foundation for agents to build fast and with high quality on our code base. This includes custom MCP servers, our background agent platform, and end-to-end agentic loops. This is an open engineering problem, not a solved one, and you'll be shaping our answer to it.

Your work multiplies across 25+ engineers. A design system component you build gets used in a hundred screens. A CI pipeline you cut from 15 minutes to 2 gives the whole org back a day a week. Foundation is the highest-leverage place in our engineering org, and the leverage is measurable.

Millions of students use what you ship. Foundation isn't a team that only builds for other engineers. You'll also build features that land in front of millions of users.

Real ownership, early. We're a small team with a large surface. You'll own meaningful pieces of the app and the toolchain from your first months.

Craft is taken seriously. We care how the app feels: how a sheet animates, how a list scrolls under load, how a component behaves at the edges. If you've ever been quietly annoyed by four pixels, you'll fit in here.

Find out more here!: This AI studying app with 25M+ downloads is built with Flutter

 


What you'll work on

Mobile foundation. The core of our Flutter app: shared components, the design system, state management, performance, and the tooling around it. You'll extend it, keep it healthy, and make it obvious for product teams to use correctly.

Agentic and AI infrastructure. MCP servers, our background agent platform, evals and feedback loops, and the integration of agentic tooling into our day-to-day workflow. A research background isn't required; a serious interest in agents as an engineering discipline is.

Developer experience. CI/CD, release tooling, and the feedback loop between writing code and seeing it live. Much of this work starts by noticing the same friction three times and deciding to remove it.

Product features. Shipping user-facing work alongside platform work, both to move the product and to stay honest about what it's actually like to build on our foundation.

Reliability and maintenance. Keeping what exists dependable, so 25+ engineers can build on it without thinking about it.



You will grow at Knowunity by

  • Learning architecture by doing it. You'll make real design decisions on the app's core, with review and mentorship from engineers who have architected mobile apps at scale. You'll see those decisions tested by 25 engineers and millions of users within weeks.

  • Becoming genuinely strong at agentic engineering. Almost nobody is an expert here yet. You'll be building the practice for a whole engineering org while the field is still being written.

  • Widening past mobile. Foundation's scope covers Go services, infrastructure, and delivery. You'll be expected to have opinions beyond the app, and you'll have the room to develop them.

  • Working close to the whole org. Platform work means talking to every team. You'll get an unusually complete picture of how a product organisation actually functions, faster than you would inside a single product team.

  • Operating at real scale. Millions of users, 26 countries, and a codebase where "it works on my machine" isn't the finish line.



What we're looking for

Must haves

  • A few years of production experience building mobile (we use Flutter and Dart) or web applications.

  • Daily use of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and opinions on where they work well, where they don't, and how to work around it.

  • An eye for design. You notice when spacing is inconsistent, when an animation feels wrong, when a component is close but not right.

  • Clear communication in English and a genuine preference for improving systems that slow other people down, whether or not your name ends up on a shipped feature.

Nice to haves

  • Built mobile apps with Flutter

  • Worked with Golang (or similar backend language)

  • Anything you've built with agents, MCP, or evals.

title: Werkstudent Go-To-Market & Partner Management (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen. Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde. Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben. Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen. Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch. Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einem Kalender. Konkret: ANRUFEN, NICHT ABTELEFONIEREN: Du stellst das neue Produkt bei Bestandspartnern vor.
