In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence.

We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Most agent frameworks are designed for short-lived workflows, best-effort execution, and a narrow set of tools. Callosum is building for a different world: agents that run for weeks, operate across distributed infrastructure, and interact with stateful systems where failures, retries, and side effects must be handled explicitly. Success in this environment requires an agent runtime built entirely from first principles.

Sitting at the heart of our technical mission, this position owns the runtime and programming model for long-running agent systems. Your focus will span durable execution, checkpointing and replay, distributed scheduling, secure tool execution, and end-to-end observability. You will develop the core software that makes agent workflows reliable, debuggable, reproducible, and efficient as we expand our model and tool footprint. This is a high-leverage role tackling complex systems challenges across the entire stack.

Runtime, observability tooling, and framework design are three separate specialties. We are glad to hire someone with real depth in a combination of them.

What You'll Build

  • Design and build stateful, asynchronous agent runtimes across distributed environments

  • Define event histories, checkpoint and resume semantics, deterministic reconstruction, retries, cancellation, timeouts, and recovery from partial failure

  • Build traces and replay, time-travel debugging, and hierarchical tracing across model calls, tools, handoffs, state changes, and runtime decisions

  • Develop clear Python APIs, libraries, and DSLs with stable extension points for tools, backends, and new execution models

  • Design scheduling, placement, backpressure, resource accounting, sandboxing, permissions, and isolation for secure tool execution at scale

  • Develop tooling for trajectory collection and visualisation, performance profiling, experiment comparison, failure attribution, and regression detection across models, prompts, tools, and runtime versions

What You'll Bring

We are looking for real strength in some of the following rather than coverage of all of it.

  • Strong distributed systems background with hands-on experience in durable workflows, actor systems, schedulers, workflow engines, distributed databases, or stream processors

  • Experience designing a library, framework, runtime, or DSL that other engineers or researchers adopted

  • Deep Python expertise plus proficiency in a systems language such as Rust, C++, or Go - and the instinct to move between abstraction layers when it matters

  • Hands-on debugging skills across APIs, runtimes, and distributed infrastructure - with a practical understanding of nondeterminism, side effects, and reproducibility

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience building a production-grade runtime, compiler, workflow engine, distributed training system, database, debugger, or orchestration platform

  • Meaningful contributions to systems such as Ray, Temporal, Kafka, Erlang/BEAM, PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow, or comparable projects

  • Strong API design judgement, open-source collaboration, and disciplined approaches to testing, versioning, compatibility, and reproducibility

  • Experience in ML systems or large-scale inference and training

  • Equity & Ownership

  • Private healthcare

  • We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us

We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Job title: Technical GTM Lead

Location: London; full in-office working as default

Start date: ASAP

Reports to: CRO

Compensation: Salary and Equity options available for discussion

Application deadline: 01/11/26 at 23:59 UK time

___________________________________________________________________________

Help put frontier AI to work in the real world

Cosine is a UK AI lab building models, applications and training infrastructure for mission-critical organisations.

We build coding agents that work across real software systems, specialised Lumen models, AI-native security products and the infrastructure needed to deploy advanced AI in demanding environments. Our customers include some of the world’s largest enterprises, including organisations operating behind strict security, regulatory and technical constraints.

We’re also training Lumen Sovereign, the first frontier large language model trained in the UK, with the support of the UK Government.

We’re now looking for a Technical GTM Lead to become the technical centre of gravity for our go-to-market team.

You’ll sit at the intersection of customers, sales, product, engineering and machine learning. You’ll show prospective customers what Cosine can do, help existing customers get deployed, build the technical assets that make our products compelling, and ensure what we learn in the field directly improves what we build.

This is not a traditional solutions consultant role. It is highly hands-on. One day you may be running a technical evaluation with an enterprise engineering team; the next you may be debugging a deployment, building a demonstration environment, writing a technical blog or working with ML researchers to turn a new capability into something customers can understand and use.

___________________________________________________________________________

What you’ll do

Make Cosine real for customers

  • Lead technical demonstrations and evaluations for prospective enterprise customers.

  • Understand a customer’s development environment, architecture, security model and constraints, then tailor the conversation accordingly.

  • Explain Cosine’s products, models, integrations, deployment options and security considerations with accuracy and confidence.

  • Design and run technical evaluations, pilots and proofs of concept.

  • Work alongside the commercial team to help turn technical interest into customer momentum.

Build the technical GTM engine

  • Create high-quality demo environments that show Cosine at its best.

  • Build reusable repositories, workflows and customer scenarios across our coding agent, desktop application and Sparklr model-training platform.

  • Develop technical materials that help the wider GTM team explain, demonstrate and position Cosine effectively.

  • Work with Product, Engineering and ML to turn new capabilities into compelling customer-facing demonstrations.

  • Create technical content such as blogs, product pages, webinars and enablement materials.

Get customers successfully deployed

  • Own the technical side of customer onboarding, from initial architecture conversations through to a working deployment.

  • Help customers integrate Cosine with their existing repositories, development environments, infrastructure and enterprise systems.

  • Support deployments across cloud, VPC, on-premise and other controlled environments.

  • Troubleshoot issues directly and coordinate with Engineering when deeper product support is required.

  • Lead onboarding sessions and become a trusted technical counterpart for customer engineering, platform, security and AI teams.

Connect customers, GTM and the product organisation

  • Act as the primary technical bridge between GTM and Cosine’s Product, Engineering and ML teams.

  • Bring structured customer feedback into the product organisation, including recurring questions, blockers, feature requests and deployment issues.

  • Identify patterns across customer conversations and distinguish one-off requests from strategically important product gaps.

  • Help the GTM team understand new technical capabilities, product changes and their implications for customers.

  • Help Product and ML understand what enterprise customers actually need in order to adopt Cosine.

Raise the technical bar

  • Become the first port of call for technical questions from the commercial team.

  • Build enough depth across Cosine’s products and underlying technology to explain not only what they do, but how and why they work.

  • Help the GTM team communicate technical capabilities accurately and avoid overpromising.

  • Train, document and support the wider commercial organisation.

  • Create a culture where technical rigour and commercial momentum reinforce each other.

___________________________________________________________________________

What we’re looking for

You may have come from software engineering, solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineering, developer tooling, technical product or a similar technical customer-facing role.

You should be comfortable:

  • Reading, writing and debugging code.

  • Working with Git, CI/CD, APIs, containers and cloud infrastructure.

  • Understanding enterprise deployment architectures, including cloud, VPC and on-premise environments.

  • Speaking credibly with software engineers, platform teams, security teams and technical executives.

  • Learning complex products quickly and explaining them clearly.

  • Debugging ambiguous customer problems and finding a practical path forward.

  • Moving between a customer meeting, a terminal and a conversation with an ML or Product team without losing context.

  • Making sound technical judgements without pretending to know what you do not know.

Experience with LLMs, coding agents, ML infrastructure or enterprise AI deployment would be valuable. But deep curiosity, technical ability and strong customer instincts matter more than having worked in exactly the same category before.

You do not need to be an ML researcher or the world’s best infrastructure engineer. You do need to be able to go deep when required, find the right answer quickly and communicate it in a way that earns trust.

___________________________________________________________________________

What success looks like

In your first three months, you will:

  • Become the person the GTM team relies on for difficult technical customer conversations.

  • Independently run excellent demonstrations across Cosine’s core products.

  • Build a useful library of repeatable demo environments, workflows and technical assets.

  • Reduce the friction and time involved in getting enterprise customers deployed.

  • Establish a strong feedback loop between customers, GTM, Product, Engineering and ML.

  • Give the commercial team confidence that Cosine can engage deeply with technically sophisticated customers.

Longer term, you will help define how Cosine is understood, evaluated and adopted by the world’s most demanding engineering organisations.

___________________________________________________________________________

Why this role matters

Cosine is building technology that cannot be sold through a slide deck alone.

Our customers want to see the product working in their environments. They want to understand how it behaves across complex codebases, legacy systems, security boundaries and real development workflows. They want technically honest answers and a partner who can stay with the problem when deployment gets difficult.

You will be that person.

You’ll have unusual proximity to customers, product decisions and the underlying research. You’ll help shape the demonstrations, deployments and feedback loops that determine where Cosine goes next.

If you enjoy being close to the technology, close to customers and close to the teams building the future of AI, this is an opportunity to have a significant impact.

Come help make frontier AI useful.

___________________________________________________________________________

Why join Cosine

  • Opportunity to sell a genuinely differentiated product into mission-critical defence and national security environments

  • Meaningful early equity with real upside

  • Direct impact on product direction and go-to-market strategy

  • Small, elite team with high standards and strong technical depth

___________________________________________________________________________


Cosine is an equal opportunity employer.


We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and ways of thinking, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace.

We encourage applications from anyone who meets the role requirements, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the hiring process, we’re happy to discuss them.

___________________________________________________________________________

Compensation, Benefits & Ways of Working

We’re an in-office team, five days a week, by design. We believe the work we’re doing benefits from being together, collaborating closely, and building shared context.

What you can expect:

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market

  • Equity / share options, so you share in the upside you help create

  • 30 days’ holiday + bank holidays

  • Work hard in the office, collaborate closely, and switch off properly

  • Dog-friendly office — bring your dog to work

  • Daily lunch provided

  • Monthly team breakfasts

  • Monthly socials

  • Pension

  • High-quality equipment to do your best work

We care about focus, sustainability, and doing great work — not performative overwork. We value people who show up, contribute thoughtfully, collaborate well with their colleagues, and then go home.

This role won’t suit everyone. But if you want structure, clarity, strong collaboration, and a team that takes both the work and work-life balance seriously, it’s a great place to be.

Warehouse Supervisor

Location: Manchester (M12)

Working pattern: Onsite | Full-time | Shift-based (37.5 hours per week)

Pay: £14.30 per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Supervisor to join our Manchester team. In this role, you’ll be the beating heart of our daily site operations, maximizing customer satisfaction by ensuring our loyal customers receive their household essentials as quickly as possible.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the HOP Operations team. This team is responsible for the end-to-end management of our rapid grocery delivery sites, ensuring inventory accuracy and lightning-fast dispatch.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Dispatch Excellence: Oversee that all orders are picked to meet time targets and lead the dispatch area to ensure seamless packing for our customers.

  • Manage Inventory Rigour: Unload deliveries according to procedure, ensuring total accuracy of product locations, date rotations, and claims logging.

  • Maintain Operational Standards: Ensure the warehouse remains clean, tidy, and safe at all times, dealing with hazards urgently and conducting regular H&S checks.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Partner with the Warehouse Assistant Manager and Manager to ensure the site runs smoothly and employees follow company procedures.

  • Ownership of Stock Integrity: Ensure stock counts are 100% accurate across all designated counting areas.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Operational Experience: Proven ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments (FMCG, Retail, Warehouse, or Last-mile delivery is a major plus).

  • Performance Driven: A track record of hitting goal targets, such as pick times or dispatch KPIs.

  • Natural Leadership: A "lead by example" mentality with a genuine passion for motivating and coaching junior team members.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to finding new ways to improve site operations and resolve challenges as they arise.

  • Adaptability: The ability to work autonomously while contributing to a high-energy, positive team environment.

Our Interview Process

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Why Join Us?

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. In Operations, you’re at the heart of our marketplace — working directly with customers, riders and partners to keep Deliveroo moving.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop leadership skills in a fast-paced environment with structured progression pathways.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

  • 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Many roles offer flexible scheduling, including evening and weekend shifts.

What We Offer

  • Free monthly Friday lunch on Deliveroo

  • 25 days’ holiday (with increases based on service)

  • Career development and access to learning opportunities

  • Life assurance and wellbeing support

  • Access to great discounts and free Deliveroo Plus!

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or belief.

raw.title: First RevOps
raw.description:
At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.


Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

Context

Our coding agent is live in 70 hospitals across France. In March, we raised $20M from Index Ventures to push it further and build what comes next: billing, admissions, patient records.

The next six months are going to move fast. We'll double to +60 people, open Germany, and triple the size of our Revenue team. Today, too much of how we run the company still depends on manual work and tools that don't talk to each other.

Nobody owns this problem yet, it will be yours.

Your mission

Make sure Parallel can double without drowning in manual work.

Attio, our CRM, will be your main tool, and you'll run it end to end. You'll also sit with each team, see what they still do by hand, and automate it yourself. On top of that, you'll work on Sales, Marketing and Finance Ops topics, like billing, cash tracking and commissions.

You'll report to Clem, our Ops Lead, and work every day with the founders and the go-to-market teams. You build things, you don't write decks about them. There's no team to manage at first, but the function is yours to shape, and we assume it will grow.

What you'll do

Own Attio, end to end

  • Administer and configure Attio: data model, pipelines, fields, views, access rights and workflows

  • Enrich our CRM with data valuable for Sales, Ops and Finance teams, so that it can be the source of truth while scaling

  • Connect Attio to the rest of our stack so processes run without manual steps

  • Support users and turn their pain points into better configurations

Automate our internal work, with AI where it makes sense

  • Map repetitive tasks across Sales, Marketing, Ops and Finance, and prioritize them by impact and effort

  • Build automations, integrations and AI use cases yourself, with no-code or low-code tools, and APIs when needed

  • Pick a simple rule or AI depending on the need, test on real cases, and keep a human in the loop when it matters

  • Protect sensitive data, control access, and measure time saved, errors and costs

Make Sales and Ops steering reliable

  • Help define the priority metrics and agree on shared definitions

  • Run the analyses, SQL queries and dashboards yourself

  • Automate data collection and updates to kill manual reporting

Build processes that hold as we double

  • Document the rules, owners, limits of AI use and what to do when something breaks

  • Structure the handoffs between teams, train users and check real adoption in the field

Outcomes

You ship from week one: automations are expected in your first month, not in six.

Month 1: diagnose and ship a first win

  • You run Attio autonomously, have audited its configuration and data, and shipped the first improvements teams feel

  • A prioritized list of automation and AI opportunities, and a 90-day plan validated with Clem

  • Your first automation is live, tested with its users, with a baseline measured to track the gain

Month 2: deploy and measure

  • Several automations are used by the teams, with time saved and output quality tracked on real cases

  • Priority metrics are live and tested with the teams

Month 3: stabilize and drive adoption

  • Several automations run in production, used regularly, with error monitoring and a clear maintenance owner

  • Attio and our data are reliable enough for the priority processes, and shared metrics are used to make decisions

  • Users are trained, and your 6-month extension plan is validated with Clem

Month 6: scale what works

  • The solutions that work are extended, documented and monitored

  • The key handoffs between teams are structured and adopted, keeping pace as we grow to around 60 people and open Germany

You are

The non-negotiable

  • You have run a CRM yourself, not just used it. You have administered, configured and optimized one personally: data model, pipelines, permissions, workflows, integrations. Attio experience is a plus; if you come from another CRM, you can show you will master Attio fast. Strong automation or AI skills won't make up for this one

Also essential

  • 3-5 years of RevOps, SalesOps or BizOps experience in a B2B startup, with business automations you built and shipped yourself

  • Real use of AI applied to internal work, and the judgment to know when a simple rule does the job better

  • At ease with data: you write SQL, run your own analyses and build dashboards; you ship a working v1 fast, then improve it

  • Autonomous and pragmatic: you don't wait for a detailed spec, you go after the high-impact problems and deliver simple, usable solutions

  • Rigorous: you check your work, set up controls and document so processes are reproducible

  • You explain technical topics simply to business teams, and get them to agree on rules and actually adopt them

Nice to have

  • A solid understanding of how a SaaS business works, from sales cycle to operations to billing

And you share our values

  • Play to Win: you set ambitious, measurable goals and own the result

  • High Trust, High Standards: you keep your commitments, raise risks early and hold a high quality bar

  • Low Ego, Hands-On: you take feedback, change course when facts say so, and do the unglamorous work yourself

  • Win as One Team: you put the collective goal ahead of your own scope

  • Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously: you own your mistakes and keep perspective when things get tense

Hiring process

  1. First call with Wallerand: our values, your background, and a first look at your CRM and automation experience

  2. Interview with Clem, Ops Lead: your future manager, deep dive into how you build and run a CRM and your automations

  3. Case study at our Paris office with Paul (CEO) and Clem: you structure and configure a CRM, then automate a process, from framing to a working prototype

  4. Founder interview with Paul

  5. Reference checks, with your consent

  6. Offer

Why should you join us?

  • AI with real-world impact. Our agents free hospital teams from paperwork, in a system where 70% of French hospitals are in deficit

  • A function to build from scratch. You are our first RevOps: the stack, the processes and how we use AI internally are yours to design

  • The right moment. A $20M Series A closed in March 2026, the team doubling to around 60 people, Germany opening, and everything still to build

  • An AI-native company that practices what it sells. We automate hospitals; you get to automate Parallel

  • Top-tier backers and founders. Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, the CEO of Mistral AI; founders from Meta, McKinsey and Hublo

  • Direct line to the founders. You work daily with Paul and the founding team, and your work shapes how the company scales

  • Room to grow. The role starts hands-on, with the prospect of building a team as the function grows

  • Competitive package. A competitive salary and equity (BSPCE), so you share in what you help build

 
 
 

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

raw.title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
raw.description:
TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

 

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

 

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

 

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

 

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

 

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

 

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

• Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié

raw.description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About the Role
As a Customer Support Engineer, youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.

This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.

Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.


Tech Profile

  • Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js.

  • Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.

  • Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.

  • Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
    experiment and iterate.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
    cause of issues.

Must Have

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
    technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
    tight deadlines.

  • Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
    propose solutions.

  • Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
    action.

  • Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

 

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

_______________________

Domaine : Numérique
Nature du poste : Pérenne
Statut : Fonctionnaire - ouvert aux contractuels
Corps : SA / TSMA
Cotation RIFSEEP : G2.B



Pour les contractuels
Fondement juridique du contrat : L 332-1
Niveau d’études : à partir du niveau Bac
Durée du contrat : jusqu’à 3 ans

Date de vacance de l’emploi : Immédiat
Date limite de candidature : 09/11/2026

________________________

Environnement professionnel

L’Agence de services et de paiement est un établissement public dédié à l’instruction, au contrôle et au paiement d’aides publiques.

La direction régionale Bourgogne-Franche-Comté compte 2 sites : Dijon, son siège, et Besançon. Aux 55 titulaires s’ajoute un nombre variable de CDD (pouvant aller jusqu’à 50).

Le service des affaires générales et informatiques (SAGI) compte 6 agents sur Dijon et 2 agents sur Besançon.

Objectifs

Le service SAGI compte trois secteurs :

  • Budget/logistique

  • Ressources humaines

  • Informatiques dont SSI

Objectifs du poste :

  • Suivi informatique des équipement du site

  • Correspondant SSI et gestion des habilitations des deux sites

  • Suivi du matériel des deux sites

  • Appui domaine logistique et budget

Missions

  • Domaine informatique

    • Installation et configuration :

      • Réalise l'installation initiale des équipements informatiques

      • Garantit le bon fonctionnement des équipements et veille au respect des politiques informatiques (charte, cybersécurité)

      • Conçoit des requêtes pour valoriser les données.

    • Assistance et support utilisateurs :

        • Assure le support de niveau 1 ; diagnostique et résout les incidents matériels,

        • Assite et conseille les utilisateurs dans la prise en main des outils bureautiques et en matière de sécurité

    • Gestion du parc :

      • Assure l’inventaire du matériel et tient à jour les référentiels de son site 

  • Domaine de la logistique et de la gestion patrimoniale

    • Assure la liquidation des factures en lien avec le/la référent(e) budget

    • Suit l’intégralité des matériels de la Direction régionale (gestion Immonet/Dépollution/Destruction/Dons…)

    • Appui à la gestion du parc automobile du site

  • Sécurité des systèmes d’information

    • Assure le rôle de Correspondant SSI de la direction régionale

    • Réalise la gestion des habilitations

  • Appui inter-site

    • Le poste pourra comporter des missions relatives au suivi de projets immobiliers le cas échéant.

Champ relationnel

  • En interne :

    • Les directions du siège de l’établissement et plus particulièrement DNSI (Direction du Numérique et des Système d’Information) et DFJL (Direction Financière, Juridique et Logistique)

    • Agents de la Direction régionale

  • En externe :

    • Les interlocuteurs locaux : les prestataires de service et les fournisseurs (maintenance et entretien du site)

Savoirs

  • Connaissance de l’environnement professionnel et de ses enjeux

  • Connaissance des réglementations et des circulaires relatives domaines couverts par le SAGI

  • Connaissance  Windows, suite bureautique Microsoft et des logiciels de gestion spécifiques (GLPI, JIRA, CWT…)

Savoir-faire

  • Capacité à rendre compte

  • Capacité d’analyse

  • Capacité à communiquer

  • Capacité à travailler en équipe

Savoir être

  • Esprit d’initiative

  • Rigueur

  • Autonomie

  • Sens des relations humaines

  • Respect de la confidentialité

Conditions particulières d’exercice

Peut participer à des groupes de travail internes ou externes notamment dans le domaine informatique (Réseau Valo / Informatique régionale / appui CSP...).

Le poste peut nécessiter des déplacements sur l’autre site de la DR (Dijon)

________________________

Contacts pour tout renseignement

Frédéric Rousseau – Chef de service SAGI

03 80 72 61 96 – ----- Lime – Directrice régionale

03 80 72 61 73 – -----

title: Software Engineer Intern - France, Paris
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://www.dataiku.com/?utm_source=newswire&amp;utm_medium=press-release&amp;utm_campaign=PlatformforAISuccess" target="_blank">Dataiku</a> is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.<br><br>The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku <a href="https://blog.dataiku.com/?_gl=1*17edvf4*_ga*MjA1Mjk5NzY4OC4xNjY3MjMyMDUz*_ga_B3YXRYMY48*MTY2OTA1MDY5NS4xMi4xLjE2NjkwNTA2OTguNTcuMC4w" target="_blank">blog</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/dataiku/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/dataiku" target="_blank">X</a>, and <a href="https://www.youtube.com/dataiku" target="_blank">YouTube</a>.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Why join Dataiku?&nbsp;</span><br></strong></span></p> <p>Dataiku’s on-premise, cloud, or SaaS-deployed platform connects many data science technologies, and our technology stack reflects our commitment to quality and innovation. We integrate the best of data and AI tech, selecting tools that truly enhance our product. From the latest LLMs to our dedication to open source communities, you'll work with a dynamic range of technologies and contribute to the collective knowledge of global tech innovators.&nbsp;Here are some useful links so you preview what we do at Dataiku: <a href="https://www.dataiku.com/product/key-capabilities/">Dataiku's Key Capabilities</a> ; <a href="https://github.com/dataiku">Dataiku's Github</a>, you can also take a look at the <a href="https://gallery.dataiku.com/home/">Gallery</a>, a public instance showcasing some example projects (note editing is very limited and will be regularly reset).&nbsp;</p> <p>Our product is called Dataiku DSS which stands for Dataiku Data Science Studio. If you’d like to know more about it, you can watch the demo <a href="https://www.dataiku.com/product/watch-a-demo">here</a> or try the free version <a href="https://pages.dataiku.com/interactive-data-sheet?utm_id=14648494444--148281341717--655855787975--dataiku%20trial&amp;utm_source=emea-adwords&amp;utm_medium=paid-search&amp;utm_campaign=GLO%20CONTENT%20Interactive%20Data%20Sheet&amp;gad_source=1&amp;gclid=CjwKCAjw1K-zBhBIEiwAWeCOF63Lb-1EuHX8HNe5jIbCBbocmW7C8tLI4gVUK1edcWBsZSn_n5BGYBoCwA0QAvD_BwE">here</a>.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt;">How you’ll make an impact&nbsp;</span><br></strong></span></p> <p>At DKU, we have multiple engineering teams focusing on various aspects of the software, including <strong>AI/ML, MLOps, Data Preparation, Data Visualization, and Cloud Platform. </strong>Each team offers internship opportunities where you'll work on specific features with direct impact on the final product. During the interview process, you'll receive detailed information about the available features and their contribution to the overall project.</p> <p>As an intern, you will be working with more senior software engineers every day on a potential future feature of our product. With guidance and support, you will be able to code, debug, optimize, and document your work while learning how to deliver qualitative work.</p> <p>The stack may differ from one internship to another, but the global stack of Dataiku is <strong>Python/Java</strong> for the backend and <strong>Angular/Vue/React</strong> for the frontend.</p> <p>Here are <strong>some examples </strong>of previous projects our interns worked on:</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Unsupervised models:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Improve the tooling available for data scientists to train unsupervised (clustering) models in Dataiku</li> <li>If time allows, extend further to optimize the training and inference of those types of models</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Webapp vibe coding:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Build an intelligent “vibe coding” assistant that interprets a user’s intent and aesthetic preferences to automatically generate functional web app code</li> <li>Prototype and refine techniques that translate natural-language descriptions into usable web components, accelerating web app development for users without deep front-end expertise</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Dynamic model management:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Improve management of AI models accessible on already-deployed software to unlock new capabilities without upgrading</li> <li>Leverage Dataiku’s LLM Mesh and accelerate customer adoption, helping shape Dataiku’s strategy for agentic AI in the enterprise</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>AI-powered code generation:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Develop and integrate more low-setup code completion features into Dataiku's embedded code editors</li> <li>As a time-permitting extension, investigate and potentially implement more AI-powered code generation capabilities to further enhance the coding experience</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Flow Search:&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Significantly enhance the search and filtering capabilities for Dataiku's complex data pipelines by introducing advanced operators</li> <li>Implement this powerful search feature by defining a formal query grammar, building an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) to parse user input, and developing a user-friendly interface with live autocompletion and intelligent error feedback</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Internationalization:&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Actively contribute to the internationalization of the Dataiku platform by allowing faster translation of new and existing software components into various languages beyond English</li> <li>Improve and optimize the entire internationalization workflow by implementing technical solutions such as lazy loading for resources, automating translations with LLMs, and developing tools for automated error detection</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Files Processor:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Develop a versatile, all-in-one file processing tool within Dataiku to perform a wide range of transformations and filtering on unstructured data, such as resizing images, converting documents (e.g., DOCX to PDF), and more</li> <li>Streamline data preparation workflows by embedding these file manipulation capabilities directly into Dataiku pipelines, improving user efficiency and reducing the need for external tools</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Geo-Grouping:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Develop and implement a new geospatial transformation tool within the Dataiku platform to compute the convex hull of sets of geometric shapes (points and polygons)</li> <li>Enhance Dataiku's capabilities by enabling customers to geo-group their data, unlocking advanced spatial analytics for use cases in fields like retail and logistics</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Cloud Engineering:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Contribute to the launchpad SaaS portal of Dataiku, building full-stack features and leveraging Kubernetes to deliver scalable, secure instance management for companies</li> <li>Improve platform reliability and developer confidence by implementing safe rollouts (feature flags), deep observability (tracing, metrics, dashboards), and broader automated test coverage</li> </ul> <p><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What does the hiring process look like?&nbsp;</span><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Initial call with a member of our technical recruiting team (30 min) with a presentation of various internship subjects</li> <li>Technical assessment to show your skills (take-home test)</li> <li>Discussion with the technical recruiter to select the internship topic (15-30 min)&nbsp;</li> <li>Video call with your future manager (1h)</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Benefits and Perks:&nbsp;</span><br></strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Ideal location: we are based in the heart of Paris in Gare de Lyon</li> <li>50% reimbursement on Navigo Transport pass and up to 5 paid leaves</li> <li>Free breakfasts, snacks, and drinks in our office every day and access to the office canteen</li> <li>Opportunities to work with a unique mix of talents and fast career opportunities</li> <li>A great place to learn: you will master the key skills of the tech world</li> <li>Be part of the AI revolution and learn how we support our customers</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>What are you waiting for!</strong></div> <div>At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/dataiku/">Dataiku LinkedIn page</a>.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><em>Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.&nbsp;All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: </em><a class="postings-link" ---------- <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><hr></div> <div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity</strong></div> <div><em>Dataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. Other than our video-conference application, Zoom, we will also never ask you to make purchases or download third-party applications during the process. If you experience something out of the ordinary or suspect fraudulent activity, please review our page on identifying and reporting fraudulent activity&nbsp;<a href="https://www.dataiku.com/legal/dataiku-recruitment-scams/" target="_blank">here.</a></em></div> </div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Solutions Architect f/m/d
description: <p>Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.</p> <h3>Why this role</h3> <p>You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.</p> <ul> <li><strong>High trust.</strong> You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.</li> <li><strong>High visibility.</strong> Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.</li> <li><strong>High freedom.</strong> You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.</li> <li><strong>Fast iteration.</strong> We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.</li> </ul> <h3>Your mission</h3> <p>Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.</p> <h3>What you will do</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Technical discovery and solution scoping.</strong> Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.</li> <li><strong>Proofs of concept.</strong> Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.</li> <li><strong>Agents and automations.</strong> Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions.</strong> Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.</li> <li><strong>Post-sale health checks and expansions.</strong> Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.</li> <li><strong>Reusable assets.</strong> Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.</li> <li><strong>Thought leadership.</strong> Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.</li> <li><strong>Product feedback.</strong> Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.</li> </ul> <h3>How you work</h3> <ul> <li>You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work.</li> <li>You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises.</li> <li>You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early.</li> <li>You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects.</li> <li>You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product.</li> </ul> <h3>Who you work with</h3> <p>Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership.&nbsp;</p> <h3>What you bring</h3> <p><strong>Must have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms</li> <li>Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design</li> <li>Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents</li> <li>A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day</li> <li>Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams</li> <li>Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal</li> <li>Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions</li> <li>Clear, structured documentation habits</li> <li>Fluent English and French skills</li> <li>Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strong plus</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit)</li> <li>Experience with another cloud PMS, channel manager or payments integrations</li> <li>Enterprise architecture experience on large, multi-site projects</li> <li>Applied AI or ML background, or experience with MCP and agent platforms</li> <li>SQL and BI fundamentals</li> </ul> <h3>How we measure success</h3> <ul> <li>Architecture engagements and blueprints delivered each quarter</li> <li>Customer satisfaction with your contribution</li> <li>Adoption of recommended apps, integrations and agents</li> <li>Share of engagements served by an existing reusable pattern</li> <li>Revenue impact e.g. deal unblocked, AI adoption, or churn averted</li> </ul> <h3>Your first 90 days</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Days 1 to 30:</strong> Learn the platform and ways of working, shadow discovery and proof of concept work, and take over open customer projects.</li> <li><strong>Days 31 to 60:</strong> Lead technical discovery on live deals and run your first health check with Account Management.</li> <li><strong>Days 61 to 90:</strong> Deliver a proof of concept or short-term solution end to end with an exit plan, and share your first experiment with Product.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What We Offer</strong></h3> <h3><strong>Culture &amp; Growth</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>A Diverse &amp; International Team:</strong>&nbsp;Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.</li> <li><strong>Growth &amp; Development:</strong>&nbsp;As we scale, so do your opportunities. You’ll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy &amp; Ownership:</strong>&nbsp;Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.</li> <li><strong>Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech:</strong>&nbsp;Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you’ll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.</li> <li><strong>Competitive &amp; Fair Compensation:</strong>&nbsp;We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Perks &amp; Lifestyle</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible &amp; Remote Work Options:</strong>&nbsp;We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.</li> <li><strong>Team Connection:</strong>&nbsp;Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.</li> <li><strong>Paid Time Off:</strong>&nbsp;Enjoy&nbsp;<strong>30 days of vacation</strong>&nbsp;to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.</li> <li><strong>Health &amp; Wellbeing:</strong>&nbsp;Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our&nbsp;<strong>EGYM Wellpass</strong>&nbsp;membership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How you make an impact joining Apaleo:</strong>&nbsp;Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it’s about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.</p> <p>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Lead Client Partner, Global Accounts
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pinterest:</strong></p> <p>Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.</p> <p>Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-life/pinflex/">flexibility</a> to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.</p> <p>At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.</p> <p>Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process <a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-philosophy-on-ai-in-hiring/">here</a>.</p></div><p>Pinterest is looking for a Lead Global Client Partner to drive growth across our largest multinational advertiser partnerships. You’ll lead global commercial strategy, senior client relationships and cross-market growth initiatives, helping shape how Pinterest partners with global advertisers at scale. This role sits on the Global Accounts team and is focused on revenue acceleration, enterprise influence and multi-market execution.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead global commercial strategy for assigned enterprise partnerships, including JBPs, global negotiations and cross-market growth initiatives</li> <li>Build and maintain senior relationships with global client and agency stakeholders, positioning Pinterest as a strategic business partner</li> <li>Identify and unlock new budgets, brands, categories and geographic growth opportunities</li> <li>Align regional teams around global priorities and translate strategy into coordinated market execution</li> <li>Engage in frequent in-person client meetings and international travel to build relationships, drive alignment and unlock growth across markets</li> <li>Create scalable frameworks that reduce duplication, remove friction and increase speed across markets</li> <li>Maintain clear visibility into pipeline, risks and opportunities across assigned partnerships</li> <li>Use AI to accelerate analysis, planning and preparation, applying judgment and verification to ensure accuracy and quality</li> <li>Build AI-enabled workflows to automate repeatable tasks, synthesize information and improve productivity in a high-volume environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leading large, complex global or multi-market advertiser relationships</li> <li>Experience driving commercial growth through enterprise partnerships, strategic agreements or cross-market initiatives</li> <li>Experience working with senior client, agency and internal stakeholders</li> <li>Willingness and ability to travel frequently, including international travel, to support senior client relationships and multi-market collaboration</li> <li>Strong understanding of digital advertising, media, technology or adjacent industries</li> <li>Experience operating in ambiguous, fast-changing environments with multiple priorities</li> <li>Strong prioritization skills, including making clear trade-offs in resource-constrained environments</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve speed and quality in day-to-day work, with clear judgment, verification and ownership of final outputs</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Business, Marketing or Communications, or equivalent experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>Relocation Statement:</strong></p> <ul> <li>This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our<a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/pinflex/"> PinFlex</a> page to learn more about our working model.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In-Office Requirement Statement</strong></p> <ul> <li>We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.</li> <li>This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 3 times per week and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance from our Paris or London office.</li> <li>This role also includes frequent international travel and regular in-person client engagement.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-HYBRID</p> <p>#SL2</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. title: Platform Security Engineer
description: At Scality, we build software that stores and protects the world’s most critical data — running on Linux, inside some of the largest infrastructures on the planet, at exabyte scale, for organizations that cannot afford to fail. We are looking for a  Platform Security Engineer  to join our platform and delivery team in Paris. This is a new seat, and it exists because security work needs dedicated capacity. Absorbed as background tasks between feature tickets, it never gets the focus it deserves. You would be that dedicated capacity. This is a Linux-first, hands-on engineering role. You will not write policies for other people to implement — you will write the Python and Bash that hardens our OS, automates our vulnerability management, and proves to auditors and customers that our supply chain is sound. About Scality Scality is the leader in software-defined object storage, trusted by 1,000+ enterprises and 700M+ users worldwide across banking, healthcare, and government sectors — exactly the sectors where security posture is a purchasing criterion, not a checkbox. Industry recognition: Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for 9 consecutive years  — the only 100% software-defined storage company to hold this position since the quadrant’s inception #1 on the GigaOm Radar for Enterprise Object Storage  (2024), ahead of 17 competing vendors Gold Stevie Award 2025  — ARTESCA 3.0, Cloud Storage & Backup Solution category Net Promoter Score of 85  across RING and ARTESCA About the team You will join a small team of highly skilled Linux engineers responsible for delivering and maintaining  ADI  (Scality Autonomous Data Infrastructure), our full platform:  RING  (object storage),  S3C  (S3-compatible layer), and  SCOS  (Scality OS — our own Linux distribution). The team works across the full stack of infrastructure engineering — deep Linux system integration, RPM packaging, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and release automation. The command line is where most of our day happens, and we ship a Linux distribution to customers. How We Build We build with AI tools, in earnest rather than as an experiment. Every engineer here has Claude Code, and it is part of how we write, review, and ship code day to day. We are also designing something larger: an  AI code and delivery factory  — AI woven into the build and release chain itself, not just into the editor. That work is early and still being thought through rather than already solved. We expect it to become part of how we maintain the platform, and CVE remediation is one of the first places we think it fits: an automated path from advisory to assessment to a patched, tested, delivered build. If that sounds like a problem you would want to work on, this role sits close to it. One principle is not negotiable:  a human owns the outcome.  AI writes code here, and when it does, we own what it produces — the review, the decision to ship, the consequences, and the fix. “The tool did it” is not an explanation we accept from ourselves, and it is not one we would offer a customer. In security work that matters doubly: an answer you cannot defend is worse than no answer at all. How This Role Works Scality is building a  network of security engineers across the engineering department  — a security peer embedded in each development team, rather than a central security function working at arm’s length from the code. You would be that peer for the platform and delivery team. Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering.  The agenda is set at that level, with dedicated resources committed across the teams. You will not have to invent it alone — and you will have a voice in it: the engineers closest to the code help decide what goes on the roadmap. We will be straight with you: today security work competes with delivery commitments and too often loses. Naming an owner and funding dedicated people is how we intend to change that. You would help build that capability, not inherit a finished one. The team is accountable for the deliveries.  Security items sit on the team’s plate alongside everything else it commits to, rather than in a separate function filing tickets from the outside. You are the dedicated resource that makes them happen.  While your teammates carry releases, OS compatibility, and platform features, your time is reserved for the security work. That focus is the whole reason the seat exists. You share the team’s perimeter and its knowledge.  Same repositories, same Jira projects, same code reviews, same sprint rituals. The engineers around you have rare, hard-earned Linux depth — OS integration, RPM packaging, boot and GRUB, CI/CD, monitoring — and you will learn the platform from them. You will have peers.  Security engineers embedded in the other development teams work the same problems on different perimeters. That network is where you compare notes, share tooling, and grow into the craft. The point of the model is that security decisions get made  inside  the team that builds and ships the product, by someone who understands the build system rather than filing tickets against it. Your First Missions Two priorities are already on the roadmap, and they will shape your first year. 1. CVE exposure, answered before it is asked Customers in banking, healthcare, and government ask us, routinely and under their own audit obligations, whether our products are exposed to a given CVE. That will not stop — for them, asking  is  the compliance requirement. Today each answer is researched from scratch: a customer question becomes a ticket, the ticket becomes a hunt through SBOMs, vendor advisories, and our own configuration, and the round trip can take weeks to produce something the team is not fully confident defending. Your first mission is to invert that, so the answer already exists when the question arrives. A standing exposure record , per shipped component and per release: what the SBOM says is present, what the upstream vendor has decided (including “will not fix”, which is common on RHEL 8 and often the real answer), and whether the vulnerable code path is actually reachable in our configuration Reachability over presence.  A module shipped and loaded by a distribution default is not the same as a module configured on a live URL. That distinction is the difference between “vulnerable” and “no impact”, and it is where the engineering judgement lives Continuous CVE detection across our repositories, vendored third-party modules, container images, and shipped RPMs Wiring detection into our existing  SBOM  tooling and GitHub Actions pipelines, so exposure is computed when a release is built rather than when a customer asks A defined interface  with the security engineers and the customer-facing teams: who produces the technical assessment, who owns the wording that reaches the customer, and how both meet the response commitments in our customer security policy Durable capture.  An assessment that lives only in a ticket comment gets re-derived next release. Findings belong somewhere queryable A remediation loop with clear ownership and response targets, integrated with how the team already works in Jira AI-assisted remediation , where it fits: from advisory to proposed patch to a tested build, with a human deciding what ships Done well, a customer’s “are you affected by X?” becomes a lookup and an afternoon, not an escalation and three weeks. 2.
